name: Check contacts on Ever Platform
description: When you click 'Check on Ever Platform' on a contact, the installation sends salted hashes of that contact's VAT number, registration number or e-mail and gets back the handle of any organization that chose to be discoverable. The values themselves never leave the installation.
revoke_effect: The button is hidden and cached results are purged.
notes: Automatic checking when a contact is opened is a separate setting. It is off by default and is part of this scope text.

scope.purpose: Find an opted-in organization with this VAT number
scope.retention: Never stored. Only per-installation rate counters are kept.

scope.purpose: Find an opted-in organization with this registration number
scope.retention: Never stored. Only per-installation rate counters are kept.

scope.purpose: Find an opted-in organization with this billing e-mail
scope.retention: Never stored. Only per-installation rate counters are kept.
